description: Search ETM.ru, browse categories or brands, fetch full product details, or map a category's subcategories and brands.

brand.description: Accepts a brand id+slug (432_iek), a numeric ETM brand id (432), a brand URL (https://www.etm.ru/brand/953_navigator), or a brand-filtered catalog URL. In search and byCategory modes it filters results to that manufacturer; in byBrand mode it selects the brand to browse. Get brand ids from the Category & brand breakdown mode.
brand.title: Brand (filter for search / byCategory; required for byBrand)

categories.description: Category id+slug, a catalog URL, or a top-level slug. Examples: 5004_avtomaticheskie_vykljuchateli, https://www.etm.ru/catalog/5004_avtomaticheskie_vykljuchateli, 010_elektrika_i_svet. Old category ids that ETM has moved (e.g. 501010_…) redirect to the current page.
categories.title: Categories (mode=byCategory / categoryFacets)

city.description: ETM prices and availability are city-specific. Pass an ETM city id (77 = Moscow, 78 = Saint Petersburg) or a city name such as Москва or Санкт-Петербург. Unknown names fall back to Moscow.
city.title: City for prices and stock

inStockOnly.title: Hide products that cannot be supplied

includeDetails.description: When enabled, every search or category row is followed to its product page and enriched with specifications, images, certificates, variants, package data and stock breakdown. Costs one extra request per product.
includeDetails.title: Enrich search/category rows with full product details

includeDiscontinued.description: By default ETM hides products it has discontinued. Enable this to include them.
includeDiscontinued.title: Include discontinued products

madeInRussia.description: Use ETM's 'Сделано в России / ЕАЭС' filter.
madeInRussia.title: Only made in Russia / EAEU

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted product records for the whole run. Search result sets are capped by ETM at 1,000 products; a category can hold up to 100,000.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to collect from ETM.ru. Search finds products by keyword; Browse categories and Browse a brand page through the catalog; Product details returns full cards; Category & brand breakdown maps the assortment.
mode.title: Mode

priceHistoryKey.description: Separate price-history stores for different workflows (for example one key per product category). Only used when price tracking is enabled.
priceHistoryKey.title: Price history key

productUrls.description: Product page URLs (https://www.etm.ru/cat/nn/7416742), bare numeric product ids (7416742), or ETM codes (ETM7416742).
productUrls.title: Product URLs, IDs or ETM codes (mode=productDetails)

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords in Russian, e.g. автомат (circuit breaker), кабель (cable), розетка (socket). The legacy single-value field searchQuery is still accepted.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

trackPriceHistory.description: Store each product's price in the run's key-value store and add previousPrice, priceChange, priceChangePct and a rolling priceHistory[] to later runs. Useful for scheduled price monitoring.
trackPriceHistory.title: Track price history between runs

title: ETM Scraper Input
